question: What is the main purpose of surveying?
options: To measure and map the earth's surface
explanation: Surveying measures distances, angles and levels to prepare maps and plans of the earth's surface.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सर्भेइङको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: पृथ्वीको सतह नाप्ने र नक्सा बनाउने
explanation_ne: सर्भेइङले दूरी, कोण र स्तर नापेर पृथ्वीको सतहको नक्सा र योजना तयार गर्छ।

question: Which instrument is used to measure horizontal and vertical angles?
explanation: A theodolite measures horizontal and vertical angles accurately.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तेर्सो र ठाडो कोण नाप्न कुन उपकरण प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: थियोडोलाइटले तेर्सो र ठाडो कोण सही रूपमा नाप्छ।

question: What is the standard length of a survey chain in Nepal?
explanation: Survey chains are commonly 20 m or 30 m long in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा सर्भे चेनको मानक लम्बाइ कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: नेपालमा सर्भे चेन सामान्यतया २० मिटर वा ३० मिटर लामो हुन्छ।

question: Which instrument is used to measure distances in chain surveying?
explanation: Distances in chain surveying are measured with a chain or steel tape.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: चेन सर्भेइङमा दूरी नाप्न कुन उपकरण प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: चेन सर्भेइङमा दूरी चेन वा स्टिल टेपले नापिन्छ।

question: What is the least count of a vernier theodolite commonly used in Nepal?
explanation: A vernier theodolite commonly has a least count of 20 seconds of arc.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा सामान्यतया प्रयोग हुने भर्नियर थियोडोलाइटको लिस्ट काउन्ट कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: भर्नियर थियोडोलाइटको लिस्ट काउन्ट सामान्यतया २० सेकेन्ड चाप हुन्छ।

question: What is the main purpose of levelling?
options: To determine the height of points relative to a datum
explanation: Levelling determines the relative heights of points with respect to a datum, usually mean sea level.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लेभलिङको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: डाटमको सापेक्षमा बिन्दुहरूको उचाइ निर्धारण गर्ने
explanation_ne: लेभलिङले डाटम, सामान्यतया औसत समुद्री सतहको सापेक्षमा बिन्दुहरूको सापेक्ष उचाइ निर्धारण गर्छ।

question: What is the first reading taken on a levelling staff called?
explanation: The first staff reading taken after setting up the level is the backsight, taken on a point of known level.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लेभलिङ स्टाफमा लिइने पहिलो पढाइलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: लेभल राखेपछि लिइने पहिलो स्टाफ पढाइ ब्याकसाइट हो, जुन ज्ञात स्तरको बिन्दुमा लिइन्छ।

question: In levelling, what is the height of instrument?
options: Elevation of the line of sight above the datum
explanation: The height of instrument is the elevation of the line of collimation above the datum.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लेभलिङमा उपकरणको उचाइ भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: उपकरणको उचाइ भनेको डाटमभन्दा माथि कोलिमेसन रेखाको उचाइ हो।

question: Which method is used to check levelling work for errors?
explanation: The two-peg test checks whether the line of collimation of a level is horizontal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लेभलिङ कार्यमा त्रुटि जाँच्न कुन विधि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: टु-पेग परीक्षणले लेभलको कोलिमेसन रेखा तेर्सो छ कि छैन जाँच्छ।

question: Which material is most commonly used for building walls in Nepal?
explanation: Burnt clay brick is the most common walling material in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा पर्खाल बनाउन सबैभन्दा बढी कुन सामग्री प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: पोलेको माटोको इँटा नेपालमा सबैभन्दा सामान्य पर्खाल सामग्री हो।

question: What is the standard size of a brick in Nepal?
explanation: The standard modular brick size in Nepal is 240 × 115 × 57 mm (with mortar about 250 × 125 × 65 mm).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा इँटाको मानक आकार कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: नेपालमा मानक मोड्युलर इँटाको आकार २४० × ११५ × ५७ mm हुन्छ (मसलासहित करिब २५० × १२५ × ६५ mm)।

question: What is the main ingredient of cement?
explanation: Limestone is the main raw material of Portland cement, providing calcium oxide.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सिमेन्टको मुख्य सामग्री के हो?
explanation_ne: चुनढुङ्गा पोर्टल्यान्ड सिमेन्टको मुख्य कच्चा पदार्थ हो, जसले क्याल्सियम अक्साइड दिन्छ।

question: Which type of cement is most commonly used in Nepal?
explanation: Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC), usually grade 43 or 53, is the most commonly used cement in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा सबैभन्दा बढी कुन प्रकारको सिमेन्ट प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: साधारण पोर्टल्यान्ड सिमेन्ट (OPC), सामान्यतया ग्रेड ४३ वा ५३, नेपालमा सबैभन्दा बढी प्रयोग हुने सिमेन्ट हो।

question: What is the purpose of adding gypsum to cement?
explanation: Gypsum is added to clinker to control (delay) the setting time of cement.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सिमेन्टमा जिप्सम थप्नुको उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: सिमेन्टको जम्ने समय नियन्त्रण (ढिलो) गर्न क्लिंकरमा जिप्सम थपिन्छ।

question: How is the fineness of cement usually measured?
explanation: The fineness of cement is measured by the Blaine air permeability test (or the sieve test).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सिमेन्टको मसिनोपन सामान्यतया कसरी नापिन्छ?
explanation_ne: सिमेन्टको मसिनोपन ब्लेन वायु पारगम्यता परीक्षण (वा छल्नी परीक्षण) द्वारा नापिन्छ।

question: Which aggregate is used as coarse aggregate in concrete?
explanation: Coarse aggregate is gravel or crushed stone, usually 10–20 mm in size.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कंक्रिटमा मोटो एग्रिगेटका रूपमा कुन प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: मोटो एग्रिगेट ग्राभेल वा कुचिएको ढुङ्गा हो, सामान्यतया १०–२० mm आकारको।

question: What is the fine aggregate in concrete?
explanation: Fine aggregate is sand, with particles smaller than 4.75 mm.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कंक्रिटमा मसिनो एग्रिगेट के हो?
explanation_ne: मसिनो एग्रिगेट बालुवा हो, जसका कण ४.७५ mm भन्दा साना हुन्छन्।

question: Which wood is commonly used for doors and windows in Nepal?
explanation: Sal wood is durable and commonly used for doors, windows and structural work in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा ढोका र झ्यालका लागि सामान्यतया कुन काठ प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: सालको काठ टिकाउ हुन्छ र नेपालमा ढोका, झ्याल र संरचनात्मक काममा सामान्यतया प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: What is the main cause of dampness in buildings?
options: Rising ground moisture and rain penetration
explanation: Dampness is caused mainly by rising ground moisture, rain penetration and leaking pipes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भवनमा चिसोपनको मुख्य कारण के हो?
options_ne: जमिनको चिसो माथि उठ्नु र वर्षा छिर्नु
explanation_ne: चिसोपन मुख्यतया जमिनको चिसो माथि उठ्नु, वर्षा छिर्नु र चुहिने पाइपले हुन्छ।

question: What is the common mix ratio for M20 grade concrete?
explanation: M20 concrete commonly uses a nominal mix of 1:1.5:3 (cement:sand:aggregate).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: M20 ग्रेड कंक्रिटको सामान्य मिश्रण अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: M20 कंक्रिटमा सामान्यतया १:१.५:३ (सिमेन्ट:बालुवा:एग्रिगेट) नाममात्र मिश्रण प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: What does M20 in concrete grade mean?
options: Compressive strength of 20 N/mm² at 28 days
explanation: M20 means the concrete has a characteristic compressive strength of 20 N/mm² after 28 days of curing.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कंक्रिट ग्रेडमा M20 को अर्थ के हो?
explanation_ne: M20 को अर्थ कंक्रिटको २८ दिन क्युरिङपछि विशेषता संकुचन बल २० N/mm² हुन्छ।

question: What is the main purpose of curing concrete?
options: To keep it moist so hydration continues
explanation: Curing keeps concrete moist so the cement hydration reaction continues and strength develops.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कंक्रिट क्युरिङ गर्नुको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: यसलाई चिसो राख्ने ताकि हाइड्रेसन जारी रहोस्
explanation_ne: क्युरिङले कंक्रिटलाई चिसो राख्छ ताकि सिमेन्ट हाइड्रेसन प्रतिक्रिया जारी रहोस् र बल विकास होस्।

question: What is the water-cement ratio for good quality concrete?
explanation: A water-cement ratio of about 0.4–0.5 gives good strength and workability; higher ratios weaken concrete.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: राम्रो गुणस्तरको कंक्रिटका लागि पानी-सिमेन्ट अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: करिब ०.४–०.५ पानी-सिमेन्ट अनुपातले राम्रो बल र कार्यक्षमता दिन्छ; उच्च अनुपातले कंक्रिट कमजोर बनाउँछ।

question: Why is concrete cured after placing?
options: To keep it moist so it gains strength
explanation: Curing keeps concrete moist so hydration continues and the concrete gains strength.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कंक्रिट राखेपछि किन क्युरिङ गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: क्युरिङले कंक्रिट ओसिलो राख्छ ताकि हाइड्रेसन जारी रहोस् र कंक्रिटले बल पाओस्।

question: How long should concrete normally be cured?
explanation: Concrete is normally cured for at least 7 days, and 14 days is better for strength gain.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कंक्रिट सामान्यतया कति समय क्युरिङ गर्नुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: कंक्रिट सामान्यतया कम्तीमा ७ दिन क्युरिङ गरिन्छ, र बलका लागि १४ दिन राम्रो हुन्छ।

question: What is the purpose of reinforcement in concrete?
explanation: Concrete is strong in compression but weak in tension, so steel reinforcement is added to resist tensile forces.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कंक्रिटमा रिइन्फोर्समेन्टको उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: कंक्रिट संकुचनमा बलियो तर तन्यमा कमजोर हुन्छ, त्यसैले तन्य बल थाम्न स्टिल रिइन्फोर्समेन्ट थपिन्छ।

question: What is the minimum grade of concrete recommended for RCC work?
explanation: M20 is the minimum grade generally recommended for reinforced cement concrete work.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: RCC कार्यका लागि सिफारिस गरिएको न्यूनतम कंक्रिट ग्रेड कति हो?
explanation_ne: M20 रिइन्फोर्स्ड सिमेन्ट कंक्रिट कार्यका लागि सामान्यतया सिफारिस गरिएको न्यूनतम ग्रेड हो।

question: What is segregation in concrete?
options: Separation of coarse aggregate from the mix
explanation: Segregation is the separation of coarse aggregate from the mortar, often from dropping concrete from a height.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कंक्रिटमा सेग्रिगेसन भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: सेग्रिगेसन भनेको मोटो एग्रिगेट मोर्टारबाट छुट्टिनु हो, प्रायः कंक्रिट उचाइबाट खसाल्दा हुन्छ।

question: What is the standard size of an A1 drawing sheet?
explanation: An A1 sheet is 594 × 841 mm; A0 is 841 × 1189 mm.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: A1 ड्रइङ सिटको मानक आकार कति हुन्छ?

question: Which line is used to show the hidden edges of an object in engineering drawing?
explanation: Hidden edges are shown with dashed (short-dash) lines.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्जिनियरिङ ड्रइङमा वस्तुको लुकेका किनारा देखाउन कुन रेखा प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: लुकेका किनारा ड्यास (छोटो-ड्यास) रेखाले देखाइन्छ।

question: What is the first-angle projection used in Nepal and India?
explanation: First-angle projection, used in Nepal and India, places the object in the first quadrant.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल र भारतमा प्रयोग हुने फर्स्ट-एङ्गल प्रोजेक्सन के हो?
explanation_ne: नेपाल र भारतमा प्रयोग हुने फर्स्ट-एङ्गल प्रोजेक्सनमा वस्तु पहिलो क्वाड्रन्टमा राखिन्छ।

question: In first-angle projection, where is the top view placed relative to the front view?
explanation: In first-angle projection the top view is placed below the front view.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फर्स्ट-एङ्गल प्रोजेक्सनमा टप भ्यु फ्रन्ट भ्युको सापेक्षमा कहाँ राखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: फर्स्ट-एङ्गल प्रोजेक्सनमा टप भ्यु फ्रन्ट भ्युभन्दा तल राखिन्छ।

question: What is the scale of a drawing if 1 cm on paper represents 1 m on the ground?
explanation: 1 cm = 1 m means 1 cm represents 100 cm, so the scale is 1:100.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कागजमा १ सेमीले जमिनमा १ मिटर देखाउँदा ड्रइङको स्केल कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: १ सेमी = १ मिटर भनेको १ सेमीले १०० सेमी देखाउँछ, त्यसैले स्केल १:१०० हुन्छ।

question: Which instrument is used to draw circles in engineering drawing?
explanation: A compass is used to draw circles and arcs.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्जिनियरिङ ड्रइङमा वृत्त कोर्न कुन उपकरण प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: वृत्त र चाप कोर्न कम्पास प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

question: What is the angle of a set square commonly used in drawing?
explanation: The two standard set squares are 30°–60°–90° and 45°–45°–90°.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ड्रइङमा सामान्यतया प्रयोग हुने सेट स्क्वायरको कोण कति हुन्छ?

question: What is the purpose of a dimension line in a drawing?
options: To show the size of an object
explanation: Dimension lines show the size (length, width, height) of features of an object.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ड्रइङमा आयाम रेखाको उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: आयाम रेखाले वस्तुका विशेषताको आकार (लम्बाइ, चौडाइ, उचाइ) देखाउँछ।

question: What is a plan in building drawing?
options: A top view of a building cut at a height
explanation: A plan is the top view of a building, usually shown as a horizontal section cut about 1 m above the floor.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भवन ड्रइङमा प्लान भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: प्लान भवनको माथिल्लो दृश्य हो, सामान्यतया भुइँभन्दा करिब १ मिटर माथि तेर्सो काटेर देखाइन्छ।

question: What is an elevation in building drawing?
options: A front or side view of a building
explanation: An elevation is the front or side view of a building, showing its external appearance.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भवन ड्रइङमा एलिभेसन भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: एलिभेसन भवनको अगाडि वा छेउको दृश्य हो, जसले यसको बाहिरी रूप देखाउँछ।

question: What is a section in building drawing?
options: A view showing the inside after cutting through the building
explanation: A section is a view of the inside of a building after an imaginary vertical cut through it.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भवन ड्रइङमा सेक्सन भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: सेक्सन भनेको भवनमा काल्पनिक ठाडो काट गरेपछि भित्र देखाउने दृश्य हो।

question: What is the standard height at which a plan is cut for a building?
explanation: A building plan is drawn as a horizontal section cut about 1 m above the floor level.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भवनको प्लान काट्ने मानक उचाइ कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: भवनको प्लान भुइँको स्तरभन्दा करिब १ मिटर माथि तेर्सो काटेर बनाइन्छ।

question: What is the main purpose of a foundation?
options: To transfer the building load safely to the ground
explanation: A foundation transfers the loads of the building safely to the soil below.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: जग (फाउन्डेसन) को मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: भवनको भार सुरक्षित रूपमा जमिनमा पुर्‍याउने
explanation_ne: जगले भवनको भार सुरक्षित रूपमा तलको माटोमा पुर्‍याउँछ।

question: What is a combined footing?
options: A footing made only of stone
A footing under a single column
A footing supporting two or more columns
explanation: A combined footing supports two or more columns, used when columns are close together.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: संयुक्त फुटिङ भनेको के हो?
options_ne: दुई वा बढी स्तम्भलाई थेग्ने फुटिङ
explanation_ne: संयुक्त फुटिङले दुई वा बढी स्तम्भलाई थेग्छ, स्तम्भहरू नजिक हुँदा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Which foundation is used when the soil is weak and loads are heavy?
explanation: A raft foundation spreads the load over a large area and is used on weak soils.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: माटो कमजोर र भार भारी हुँदा कुन जग प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: राफ्ट फाउन्डेसनले भार ठूलो क्षेत्रमा फैलाउँछ र कमजोर माटोमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: What is the minimum depth of foundation for a building in Nepal?
explanation: Foundations are generally taken at least 0.9 m deep to reach stable soil below the topsoil.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा भवनको जगको न्यूनतम गहिराइ कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: जग सामान्यतया माथिल्लो माटोभन्दा तल स्थिर माटोमा पुग्न कम्तीमा ०.९ मिटर गहिरो लिइन्छ।

question: What is the most common bond used in brick masonry?
explanation: Stretcher bond, with all bricks laid as stretchers, is the most common bond for half-brick walls.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इँटा चिनाइमा सबैभन्दा बढी प्रयोग हुने बन्ड कुन हो?
explanation_ne: स्ट्रेचर बन्ड, जसमा सबै इँटा स्ट्रेचरका रूपमा राखिन्छ, आधा-इँटा पर्खालका लागि सबैभन्दा सामान्य बन्ड हो।

question: What is the standard thickness of a mortar joint in brick masonry?
explanation: Mortar joints in brick masonry are normally about 10 mm thick.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इँटा चिनाइमा मसलाको जोर्नीको मानक मोटाइ कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: इँटा चिनाइमा मसलाको जोर्नी सामान्यतया करिब १० mm बाक्लो हुन्छ।

question: In English bond, how are the courses arranged?
options: Alternate courses of headers and stretchers
explanation: English bond has alternate courses of headers and stretchers, giving a strong wall.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इङ्गलिस बन्डमा कोर्स कसरी व्यवस्थित गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: इङ्गलिस बन्डमा हेडर र स्ट्रेचरका पालोपालो कोर्स हुन्छन्, जसले बलियो पर्खाल दिन्छ।

question: What is the purpose of a queen closer in brick masonry?
options: To break the vertical joints in alternate courses
explanation: A queen closer (a brick cut in half lengthwise) is placed next to the quoin header to break continuous vertical joints.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इँटा चिनाइमा क्विन क्लोजरको उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: क्विन क्लोजर (लम्बाइमा आधा काटिएको इँटा) क्विन हेडरको छेउमा राखेर निरन्तर ठाडो जोर्नी तोड्छ।

question: What is the normal cement-sand ratio for plastering a wall?
explanation: Wall plaster commonly uses a 1:4 or 1:6 cement-sand mix.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पर्खाल प्लास्टर गर्न सामान्य सिमेन्ट-बालुवा अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: पर्खाल प्लास्टरमा सामान्यतया १:४ वा १:६ सिमेन्ट-बालुवा मिश्रण प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: What is the standard thickness of plaster on a wall?
explanation: Wall plaster is normally about 12 mm thick in a single coat.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पर्खालमा प्लास्टरको मानक मोटाइ कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: पर्खालको प्लास्टर एक कोटमा सामान्यतया करिब १२ mm बाक्लो हुन्छ।

question: Which roofing material is most common in rural Nepal?
explanation: CGI (zinc) sheets are the most common roofing material in rural Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्रामीण नेपालमा सबैभन्दा सामान्य छाना सामग्री कुन हो?
explanation_ne: CGI (जस्ता) सिट ग्रामीण नेपालमा सबैभन्दा सामान्य छाना सामग्री हो।

question: What is the main purpose of a roof slope?
explanation: A roof slope drains rainwater quickly and prevents leakage and ponding.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: छानाको ढलानको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: छानाको ढलानले वर्षाको पानी छिटो बगाउँछ र चुहावट तथा पानी जम्नबाट रोक्छ।

question: What is the standard size of a main door in a house?
explanation: A main door is commonly 0.9 m wide and 2.1 m high.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: घरको मुख्य ढोकाको मानक आकार कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: मुख्य ढोका सामान्यतया ०.९ मिटर चौडा र २.१ मिटर अग्लो हुन्छ।

question: What is the standard height of a window sill above the floor?
explanation: A window sill is usually about 0.9 m above the floor level.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भुइँभन्दा माथि झ्यालको सिलको मानक उचाइ कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: झ्यालको सिल सामान्यतया भुइँको स्तरभन्दा करिब ०.९ मिटर माथि हुन्छ।

question: What is the vertical distance between two consecutive steps called?
explanation: The riser is the vertical face between two steps; the tread is the horizontal part.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लगातार दुई खुट्किलाबीचको ठाडो दूरीलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: राइजर दुई खुट्किलाबीचको ठाडो भाग हो; ट्रेड तेर्सो भाग हो।

question: What is the horizontal part of a step called?
explanation: The tread is the horizontal surface of a step that the foot rests on.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: खुट्किलाको तेर्सो भागलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: ट्रेड खुट्किलाको तेर्सो सतह हो, जसमा खुट्टा टेकिन्छ।

question: What is the normal riser height for a residential stair?
explanation: A comfortable riser height for houses is about 150–175 mm.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आवासीय भर्‍याङका लागि सामान्य राइजर उचाइ कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: घरका लागि आरामदायी राइजर उचाइ करिब १५०–१७५ mm हुन्छ।

question: What is the thumb rule for a comfortable stair (2 × riser + tread)?
explanation: For a comfortable stair, twice the riser plus the tread should be about 550–600 mm.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आरामदायी भर्‍याङको थम्ब नियम (२ × राइजर + ट्रेड) कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: आरामदायी भर्‍याङका लागि राइजरको दोब्बर र ट्रेडको योग करिब ५५०–६०० mm हुनुपर्छ।

question: What is the area of a rectangle 10 m long and 5 m wide?
explanation: Area = length × width = 10 × 5 = 50 m².
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: १० मिटर लामो र ५ मिटर चौडा आयतको क्षेत्रफल कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: क्षेत्रफल = लम्बाइ × चौडाइ = १० × ५ = ५० वर्ग मिटर।

question: What is the volume of a cube with side 3 m?
explanation: Volume of a cube = side³ = 3³ = 27 m³.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ३ मिटर भुजा भएको घनको आयतन कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: घनको आयतन = भुजा³ = ३³ = २७ घन मिटर।

question: What is the area of a circle with radius 7 m? (Use π = 22/7)
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ७ मिटर अर्धव्यास भएको वृत्तको क्षेत्रफल कति हुन्छ? (π = २२/७ प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्)
explanation_ne: क्षेत्रफल = πr² = (२२/७) × ४९ = १५४ वर्ग मिटर।

question: What is the volume of a cylinder with radius 2 m and height 5 m? (Use π = 3.14)
explanation: Volume = πr²h = 3.14 × 4 × 5 = 62.8 m³.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: २ मिटर अर्धव्यास र ५ मिटर उचाइ भएको बेलनको आयतन कति हुन्छ? (π = ३.१४ प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्)
explanation_ne: आयतन = πr²h = ३.१४ × ४ × ५ = ६२.८ घन मिटर।

question: How many bricks are needed for 1 m³ of brick masonry (with mortar)?
explanation: About 500 bricks are needed for 1 m³ of brick masonry with mortar (standard brick with 10 mm joints).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: १ घन मिटर इँटा चिनाइ (मसलासहित) का लागि कति इँटा चाहिन्छ?
explanation_ne: मसलासहित १ घन मिटर इँटा चिनाइका लागि करिब ५०० इँटा चाहिन्छ (१० mm जोर्नीसहित मानक इँटा)।

question: What is the unit of measurement for brick masonry in estimating?
explanation: Brick masonry is measured in cubic metres (volume).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अनुमान (एस्टिमेटिङ) मा इँटा चिनाइ नाप्ने एकाइ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: इँटा चिनाइ घन मिटर (आयतन) मा नापिन्छ।

question: What is the unit of measurement for plastering in estimating?
explanation: Plastering is measured by area, in square metres.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अनुमानमा प्लास्टर नाप्ने एकाइ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: प्लास्टर क्षेत्रफलले नापिन्छ, वर्ग मिटरमा।

question: What is the unit of measurement for excavation in estimating?
explanation: Excavation (earthwork) is measured in cubic metres.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अनुमानमा उत्खनन नाप्ने एकाइ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: उत्खनन (माटोको काम) घन मिटरमा नापिन्छ।

question: What is the dry volume of concrete needed for 1 m³ of wet concrete?
explanation: The dry volume of concrete is about 1.54 times the wet volume, to allow for voids in aggregates.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: १ घन मिटर भिजेको कंक्रिटका लागि सुख्खा कंक्रिटको आयतन कति चाहिन्छ?
explanation_ne: सुख्खा कंक्रिटको आयतन भिजेको आयतनको करिब १.५४ गुणा हुन्छ, एग्रिगेटका खाली ठाउँका लागि।

question: How much cement is needed for 1 m³ of M20 concrete (1:1.5:3)?
explanation: For 1 m³ of M20 concrete, about 8 bags (400 kg) of cement are needed.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: १ घन मिटर M20 कंक्रिट (१:१.५:३) का लागि कति सिमेन्ट चाहिन्छ?
explanation_ne: १ घन मिटर M20 कंक्रिटका लागि करिब ८ बोरा (४०० kg) सिमेन्ट चाहिन्छ।

question: What is the main purpose of a soil test before construction?
options: To know the bearing capacity of the soil
explanation: Soil tests determine the bearing capacity and properties of soil so the foundation can be designed safely.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: निर्माणअघि माटो परीक्षणको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: माटोको भार वहन क्षमता थाहा पाउने
explanation_ne: माटो परीक्षणले माटोको भार वहन क्षमता र गुण थाहा पाउँछ, ताकि जग सुरक्षित रूपमा डिजाइन गर्न सकियोस्।

question: Which soil has the highest bearing capacity?
explanation: Solid rock has the highest bearing capacity of all foundation soils.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन माटोको भार वहन क्षमता सबैभन्दा बढी हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ठोस चट्टानको भार वहन क्षमता सबै आधार माटोमध्ये सबैभन्दा बढी हुन्छ।

question: What is the standard Proctor test used for?
options: To find the optimum moisture content for compaction
explanation: The Proctor test finds the optimum moisture content at which soil reaches its maximum dry density.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानक प्रोक्टर परीक्षण केका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options_ne: कम्प्याक्सनका लागि इष्टतम चिस्यान पत्ता लगाउन
explanation_ne: प्रोक्टर परीक्षणले माटो अधिकतम सुख्खा घनत्वमा पुग्ने इष्टतम चिस्यान पत्ता लगाउँछ।

question: What is the angle of repose of a soil?
options: The angle of a slope at which soil is stable
explanation: The angle of repose is the steepest angle at which loose soil remains stable without sliding.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: माटोको विश्राम कोण भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: विश्राम कोण भनेको खुकुलो माटो नचिप्लिई स्थिर रहने सबैभन्दा ठाडो कोण हो।

question: Which soil type is best for a foundation?
explanation: Gravelly soil has good bearing capacity and drains well, making it good for foundations.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: जगका लागि कुन माटो सबैभन्दा राम्रो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: ग्राभेलयुक्त माटोको भार वहन क्षमता राम्रो हुन्छ र पानी राम्रोसँग बग्छ, त्यसैले जगका लागि राम्रो हुन्छ।

question: What is the main source of drinking water in rural Nepal?
explanation: Springs and groundwater (tube wells) are the main drinking water sources in rural Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्रामीण नेपालमा पिउने पानीको मुख्य स्रोत के हो?
explanation_ne: मूल र भूमिगत पानी (ट्युबवेल) ग्रामीण नेपालमा पिउने पानीका मुख्य स्रोत हुन्।

question: What is the average daily water demand per person in Nepal (rural)?
explanation: The rural water supply design norm in Nepal is about 45 litres per person per day.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा (ग्रामीण) प्रतिव्यक्ति औसत दैनिक पानी माग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: नेपालमा ग्रामीण खानेपानी डिजाइन मापदण्ड करिब ४५ लिटर प्रतिव्यक्ति प्रतिदिन हो।

question: Which pipe material is most commonly used for water supply in Nepal?
explanation: HDPE and galvanised iron (GI) pipes are most commonly used for water supply in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा खानेपानी आपूर्तिका लागि सबैभन्दा बढी कुन पाइप सामग्री प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: नेपालमा खानेपानी आपूर्तिका लागि HDPE र ग्याल्भेनाइज्ड आइरन (GI) पाइप सबैभन्दा बढी प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: What is the purpose of a reservoir (storage tank) in a water supply system?
options: To store water and balance supply and demand
explanation: A reservoir stores water and balances supply with demand, including fire and peak needs.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: खानेपानी प्रणालीमा भण्डारण ट्याङ्की (रिजर्भोयर) को उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: पानी भण्डारण गर्ने र आपूर्ति तथा माग सन्तुलन गर्ने
explanation_ne: रिजर्भोयरले पानी भण्डारण गर्छ र आगलागी तथा उच्च मागसहित आपूर्ति र माग सन्तुलन गर्छ।

question: What is a septic tank used for?
explanation: A septic tank treats household wastewater by settling solids and anaerobic digestion.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सेप्टिक ट्याङ्की केका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: सेप्टिक ट्याङ्कीले ठोस थिग्राएर र अवायवीय पाचनबाट घरेलु फोहोर पानी उपचार गर्छ।

question: What is the minimum distance between a septic tank and a water well?
explanation: A septic tank should be at least 15 m away from a drinking water source to prevent contamination.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सेप्टिक ट्याङ्की र पानीको इनारबीच न्यूनतम दूरी कति हुनुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: दूषित हुनबाट रोक्न सेप्टिक ट्याङ्की पिउने पानीको स्रोतबाट कम्तीमा १५ मिटर टाढा हुनुपर्छ।

question: What is the main purpose of a soak pit?
options: To dispose of treated effluent into the ground
explanation: A soak pit lets treated effluent from a septic tank seep safely into the ground.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सोक पिटको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: उपचार गरिएको फोहोर पानी जमिनमा पठाउने
explanation_ne: सोक पिटले सेप्टिक ट्याङ्कीबाट उपचार गरिएको फोहोर पानी सुरक्षित रूपमा जमिनमा छिर्न दिन्छ।

question: What is the topmost layer of a road called?
explanation: The wearing course is the top layer of a road, in direct contact with traffic.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सडकको सबैभन्दा माथिल्लो तहलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: वेयरिङ कोर्स सडकको माथिल्लो तह हो, जुन सवारीसँग प्रत्यक्ष सम्पर्कमा हुन्छ।

question: What is camber in road construction?
options: The slope given to the road surface for drainage
explanation: Camber is the transverse slope of the road surface that drains rainwater to the sides.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सडक निर्माणमा क्याम्बर भनेको के हो?
options_ne: पानी निकासका लागि सडक सतहलाई दिइने ढलान
explanation_ne: क्याम्बर सडक सतहको आडो ढलान हो, जसले वर्षाको पानी छेउतिर बगाउँछ।

question: What is the standard camber for a bituminous road?
explanation: Bituminous roads usually have a camber of 1 in 40 to 1 in 60 (about 2–2.5%).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बिटुमिनस सडकको मानक क्याम्बर कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बिटुमिनस सडकमा सामान्यतया १ मा ४० देखि १ मा ६० (करिब २–२.५%) क्याम्बर हुन्छ।

question: What is the function of a subgrade in a road?
options: To support the pavement layers above
explanation: The subgrade is the prepared natural ground that supports all the pavement layers above it.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सडकमा सबग्रेडको काम के हो?
explanation_ne: सबग्रेड तयार गरिएको प्राकृतिक जमिन हो, जसले माथिका सबै पेभमेन्ट तह थाम्छ।

question: Which material is used as a binder in bituminous roads?
explanation: Bitumen is the binder that holds aggregates together in bituminous roads.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बिटुमिनस सडकमा बाइन्डरका रूपमा कुन सामग्री प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: बिटुमेन बिटुमिनस सडकमा एग्रिगेटलाई बाँध्ने बाइन्डर हो।

question: What is the main purpose of irrigation?
options: To supply water to crops when rainfall is not enough
explanation: Irrigation supplies water to crops when rainfall is insufficient for their needs.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सिँचाइको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: सिँचाइले वर्षा बालीको आवश्यकताका लागि नपुग्दा बालीमा पानी पुर्‍याउँछ।

question: Which irrigation method is most water-efficient?
explanation: Drip irrigation delivers water directly to plant roots and is the most water-efficient method.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन सिँचाइ विधि पानीको हिसाबले सबैभन्दा दक्ष हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: थोपा सिँचाइले पानी सिधै बिरुवाको जरामा पुर्‍याउँछ र पानीको हिसाबले सबैभन्दा दक्ष विधि हो।

question: What is a canal head regulator used for?
options: To control the flow of water into a canal
explanation: A head regulator controls the amount of water entering a canal from its source.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नहरको हेड रेगुलेटर केका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: हेड रेगुलेटरले स्रोतबाट नहरमा प्रवेश गर्ने पानीको मात्रा नियन्त्रण गर्छ।

question: What is the unit of discharge (flow rate) of water?
explanation: Discharge is volume per unit time, measured in cubic metres per second (m³/s).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पानीको डिस्चार्ज (प्रवाह दर) को एकाइ के हो?
explanation_ne: डिस्चार्ज प्रति एकाइ समयको आयतन हो, जुन घन मिटर प्रति सेकेन्ड (m³/s) मा नापिन्छ।

question: What is Bernoulli's theorem mainly about?
options: Conservation of energy in fluid flow
explanation: Bernoulli's theorem states that the total energy (pressure, kinetic and potential) remains constant along a streamline.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बर्नौलीको सिद्धान्त मुख्यतया केबारे हो?
explanation_ne: बर्नौलीको सिद्धान्तले स्ट्रिमलाइनमा कुल ऊर्जा (दबाब, गतिज र स्थितिज) स्थिर रहन्छ भन्छ।

question: What is the velocity of water in a pipe if discharge is 2 m³/s and area is 1 m²?
explanation: Velocity = discharge ÷ area = 2 ÷ 1 = 2 m/s.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: डिस्चार्ज २ घन मिटर/सेकेन्ड र क्षेत्रफल १ वर्ग मिटर भए पाइपमा पानीको वेग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: वेग = डिस्चार्ज ÷ क्षेत्रफल = २ ÷ १ = २ मिटर/सेकेन्ड।

question: What is the Manning formula used for?
options: To calculate flow velocity in open channels
explanation: Manning's formula estimates the velocity of flow in open channels such as canals and rivers.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: म्यानिङ सूत्र केका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: म्यानिङ सूत्रले नहर र नदीजस्ता खुला च्यानलमा प्रवाह वेग अनुमान गर्छ।

question: Which code governs earthquake-resistant building design in Nepal?
explanation: NBC 105 is the Nepal National Building Code for seismic design of buildings.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा भूकम्प प्रतिरोधी भवन डिजाइन कुन कोडले नियन्त्रण गर्छ?
explanation_ne: NBC १०५ भवनको भूकम्प डिजाइनका लागि नेपाल राष्ट्रिय भवन संहिता हो।

question: What is the main purpose of the Nepal National Building Code?
options: To ensure buildings are safe, especially against earthquakes
explanation: The NBC sets minimum standards so buildings are safe, particularly against earthquakes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्रिय भवन संहिताको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: भवन सुरक्षित होस्, विशेष गरी भूकम्प विरुद्ध
explanation_ne: NBC ले भवन सुरक्षित होस्, विशेष गरी भूकम्प विरुद्ध, भनेर न्यूनतम मापदण्ड तय गर्छ।

question: Which NBC code covers mandatory rules for load-bearing masonry buildings?
explanation: NBC 202 gives mandatory rules of thumb for load-bearing masonry buildings.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भार वहन गर्ने चिनाइ भवनका लागि अनिवार्य नियम कुन NBC कोडले समेट्छ?
explanation_ne: NBC २०२ ले भार वहन गर्ने चिनाइ भवनका लागि अनिवार्य थम्ब नियम दिन्छ।

question: What is the maximum height of a load-bearing masonry building allowed without engineering design under NBC?
explanation: Under NBC mandatory rules, load-bearing masonry buildings are generally limited to 3 storeys.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: NBC अन्तर्गत इन्जिनियरिङ डिजाइनबिना भार वहन गर्ने चिनाइ भवनको अधिकतम उचाइ कति हो?
explanation_ne: NBC अनिवार्य नियमअनुसार भार वहन गर्ने चिनाइ भवन सामान्यतया ३ तलामा सीमित हुन्छ।

question: What is the purpose of a prismatic compass?
explanation: A prismatic compass measures the magnetic bearing of survey lines.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रिज्म्याटिक कम्पासको उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: प्रिज्म्याटिक कम्पासले सर्भे रेखाको चुम्बकीय बियरिङ नाप्छ।

question: What is the difference between a fore bearing and a back bearing of a line?
explanation: The back bearing of a line differs from its fore bearing by 180 degrees.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेखाको फोर बियरिङ र ब्याक बियरिङबीच कति फरक हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: रेखाको ब्याक बियरिङ फोर बियरिङभन्दा १८० डिग्री फरक हुन्छ।

question: Which steel is commonly used as reinforcement in Nepal?
explanation: Fe 500 TMT (thermo-mechanically treated) bars are commonly used as reinforcement in Nepal.

question_ne: नेपालमा रिइन्फोर्समेन्टका रूपमा सामान्यतया कुन स्टिल प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: Fe ५०० TMT (थर्मो-मेकानिकली ट्रिटेड) बार नेपालमा रिइन्फोर्समेन्टका रूपमा सामान्यतया प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: What is the minimum concrete cover for a beam in RCC?
explanation: The minimum clear cover for beams is usually 25 mm (30 mm in severe exposure).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: RCC मा बीमका लागि न्यूनतम कंक्रिट कभर कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बीमका लागि न्यूनतम स्पष्ट कभर सामान्यतया २५ mm हुन्छ (गम्भीर सम्पर्कमा ३० mm)।

question: What is the main purpose of stirrups in a beam?
explanation: Stirrups (shear reinforcement) resist shear forces and hold the main bars in place.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बीममा स्टिरपको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: स्टिरप (सियर रिइन्फोर्समेन्ट) ले सियर बल थाम्छ र मुख्य बार ठाउँमा राख्छ।

question: Which type of slab is supported on two opposite sides only?
explanation: A one-way slab is supported on two opposite sides and bends mainly in one direction.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन प्रकारको स्ल्याब दुई विपरीत छेउमा मात्र थामिएको हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: वन-वे स्ल्याब दुई विपरीत छेउमा थामिएको हुन्छ र मुख्यतया एक दिशामा बाङ्गिन्छ।

question: What is the span-to-depth ratio used to control deflection in a simply supported slab?
explanation: For a simply supported slab, the span-to-effective-depth ratio is limited to about 20 to control deflection.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: साधारण रूपमा थामिएको स्ल्याबमा डिफ्लेक्सन नियन्त्रण गर्न प्रयोग हुने स्पान-गहिराइ अनुपात कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: साधारण रूपमा थामिएको स्ल्याबमा डिफ्लेक्सन नियन्त्रण गर्न स्पान-प्रभावकारी गहिराइ अनुपात करिब २० मा सीमित गरिन्छ।

question: What is the effective span of a simply supported beam?
explanation: The effective span is the clear span plus the effective depth (or the centre-to-centre distance of supports, whichever is less).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: साधारण रूपमा थामिएको बीमको प्रभावकारी स्पान कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: प्रभावकारी स्पान स्पष्ट स्पान र प्रभावकारी गहिराइको योग हो (वा सपोर्टको केन्द्र-देखि-केन्द्र दूरी, जुन कम हुन्छ)।

question: What is the function of a column in a building?
options: To carry vertical loads to the foundation
explanation: A column carries vertical loads from beams and slabs down to the foundation.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: भवनमा स्तम्भको काम के हो?
explanation_ne: स्तम्भले बीम र स्ल्याबबाट ठाडो भार जगसम्म पुर्‍याउँछ।

question: What is the minimum number of bars in a rectangular column?
explanation: A rectangular column must have at least 4 longitudinal bars, one at each corner.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयताकार स्तम्भमा न्यूनतम कति बार हुनुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: आयताकार स्तम्भमा कम्तीमा ४ लम्बाइ बार हुनुपर्छ, प्रत्येक कुनामा एक।

question: What is the purpose of lateral ties in a column?
options: To prevent buckling of longitudinal bars
explanation: Lateral ties hold longitudinal bars in place and prevent them from buckling.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्तम्भमा लेटरल टाइको उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: लेटरल टाइले लम्बाइ बार ठाउँमा राख्छ र तिनलाई बाङ्गिनबाट रोक्छ।

question: What is a fixed beam?
options: A beam with a hinge in the middle
A beam with both ends fixed against rotation
A beam supported at one end only
A beam with both ends free

question_ne: फिक्स्ड बीम भनेको के हो?

explanation_ne: फिक्स्ड बीमका दुवै छेउ कडाइका साथ स्थिर हुन्छन्, त्यसैले थेगमा घुमाइ र स्थानान्तरण रोकिन्छ।

question: What is the maximum bending moment in a simply supported beam with central point load W and span L?
explanation: For a central point load, the maximum bending moment at midspan is WL/4.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: केन्द्रमा बिन्दु भार W र स्पान L भएको सिम्प्ली सपोर्टेड बीममा अधिकतम बेन्डिङ मोमेन्ट कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: केन्द्रमा बिन्दु भार भएमा बीचमा अधिकतम बेन्डिङ मोमेन्ट WL/४ हुन्छ।

question: What is the maximum bending moment in a simply supported beam with uniform load w per unit length and span L?
explanation: For a uniformly distributed load, the maximum bending moment at midspan is wL²/8.

explanation_ne: समान रूपमा वितरित भारमा बीचमा अधिकतम बेन्डिङ मोमेन्ट wL²/८ हुन्छ।

question: What is a continuous beam?

A beam with only one support
A beam with a free end
A beam made of steel only

question_ne: स्वतन्त्र छेउमा बिन्दु भार भएको क्यान्टिलिभर बीममा अधिकतम बेन्डिङ मोमेन्ट कहाँ हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: स्वतन्त्र छेउमा भार भएको क्यान्टिलिभरमा बेन्डिङ मोमेन्ट स्थिर सपोर्टमा अधिकतम हुन्छ।

question: What is shear force?
options: The internal force that tends to shear a section
explanation: Shear force is the internal force acting parallel to a cross-section, tending to shear it.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सियर बल भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: सियर बल खण्डको समानान्तर कार्य गर्ने आन्तरिक बल हो, जसले खण्ड च्यात्न खोज्छ।

question: What is the unit of stress?
explanation: Stress is force per unit area, measured in N/mm² (megapascal, MPa).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्ट्रेसको एकाइ के हो?
explanation_ne: स्ट्रेस प्रति एकाइ क्षेत्रफलको बल हो, जुन N/mm² (मेगापास्कल, MPa) मा नापिन्छ।

question: What is Hooke's law?
options: Stress is proportional to strain within the elastic limit
explanation: Hooke's law states that stress is proportional to strain within the elastic limit of a material.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हुकको नियम के हो?

इलास्टिक सीमाभित्र स्ट्रेस स्ट्रेनको समानुपातिक हुन्छ

question: What is Young's modulus?

question_ne: यङ्ग मोड्युलस भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: यङ्ग मोड्युलस (इलास्टिसिटी मोड्युलस) इलास्टिक दायरामा स्ट्रेस र स्ट्रेनको अनुपात हो।

question: Which material has the highest modulus of elasticity?

question_ne: कुन सामग्रीको इलास्टिसिटी मोड्युलस सबैभन्दा बढी हुन्छ?

question: What is the purpose of a ranging rod in surveying?

question: What is the length of a standard ranging rod?

question_ne: मानक रेञ्जिङ रडको लम्बाइ कति हुन्छ?

question: What is the contour interval?

question: What is the full form of GPS?
explanation: GPS stands for Global Positioning System, which uses satellites to find positions on earth.

question: How many satellites are needed at minimum to fix a GPS position?

question_ne: GPS स्थान निर्धारण गर्न न्यूनतम कति उपग्रह चाहिन्छ?

question: What is differential levelling?

question_ne: डिफरेन्सियल लेभलिङ भनेको के हो?

explanation_ne: अंकगणितीय जाँच: ΣBS − ΣFS = अन्तिम घटाइएको स्तर − पहिलो घटाइएको स्तर।

question: What is the compressive strength of a good quality brick?

question: What is efflorescence in brickwork?

question: What is the main use of lime in construction?

question: What is the purpose of seasoning timber?

question_ne: काठ सिजनिङ गर्ने उद्देश्य के हो?

question: What is honeycombing in concrete?

question: What is the main function of a vibrator in concreting?

A brick laid with its length along the wall
